description: Look words up in Jisho, the online Japanese-English dictionary. Translate in either direction, get readings in kana, meanings, parts of speech, JLPT and WaniKani levels, search Japanese proper names, and filter by level, part of speech, usage or subject field, plus wildcard pattern searches for study lists and drills. No account or API key required.
